idea_name: VWAP-Deviation Continuation + Volatility-Regime Gate (NQ 1h NY, zero-param ATR-ratio gate, iteration 26's exit restored)

Step 4's absolute checklist fails on OOS Sharpe (-0.3227 vs >0.8) and OOS profit factor (0.8997 vs >1.2) while passing trade count (164>=30); max OOS drawdown -12.6% vs total return -4.9% has no hard vault threshold and is judged unremarkable, consistent with a slow bleed. idea_name: Run-Exhaustion Reversal (NQ 1h New York, N consecutive same-direction bars covering K ATRs, faded once, bounded ATR target)
rationale: Iteration 28 is rejected/overfit-gap, so the literal structural triggers (no-edge, or fragile-concentration twice) do NOT fire -- but the addressable menu for vwap_deviation_continuation is spent: 27 spent the exit reformulation (2R target, worse), 28 spent the zero-param filter (vol gate, worse), and no axis carries real boundary evidence (iter-028 fold_table.csv: vwap_lookback = grid-max 96 in only 18/48 folds with grid-min 12 in 10/48 -- dispersion, not pinning; target_atr_mult does pin at 4.0 in 25/48 but extending it degenerates into run-to-session-flatten, exactly the tail-carried shape gate v2's leave-top-5-out hard-fails), while best-of-grid train_sharpe sits at or below zero across twelve contiguous folds 33-44 after 1.6-5.6 through fold 32 -- and the vol-regime gate did not repair it. The new edge is mean-reversion.md's stated mechanism read as a path event rather than a level: short-term overreaction/forced buying-selling overshoots then reverts -- so a run of consecutive same-direction bars that has covered a material multiple of ATR is faded once, giving that page's documented 'frequent small wins' shape, rewarded by gate v2's leave-top-5-out check. Cost arithmetic differentiator: running at 1h means the fixed ~10.2bps round trip is ~20% of a 1-ATR NQ target vs ~40% at 15min where all seven prior fades ran; secondarily six of those seven measured the extreme as price against its own rolling mean/band/regression line (iteration 21 concluded this is information-free in either polarity), whereas a sign-sequence run says nothing about the level. Both exits bounded so P&L cannot be tail-carried. Pre-registered power floor >=120 OOS trades (met: 388).

idea_name: Volatility-Level Polarity Switch (NQ 1h NY, one ATR-displacement primitive whose sign is set by measured vol regime, regime-scaled stop, bounded 1.5R target)
rationale: Iteration 29 (run_exhaustion_reversal) is retired as structural -- IS CAGR -0.1084 and IS profit factor 0.5109<=1 over 232 IS / 388 OOS trades fire both no-edge triggers -- so this is a clean pivot; per loop-review.md the pre-v2 accepted iterations 6/10/11 are not cited here as demonstrated edge (none gets a clean leave-top-5-out pass and none transfers to ES). Step 2 corroborates at full power: 48 active folds well above the ~10 under-powered floor, and 31.25% of folds profitable against the vault's >60% aim, median fold OOS return -0.64%, median fold OOS Sharpe -2.61 -- broad-based losses. Step 3 returns robust:false via the profit-factor rule only (PF_ex5 0.5155<0.9), not sign flip -- both legs negative, removing top 5 winners deepens the loss to -0.4262; with 335 OOS trades fully informative, confirms rather than drives the verdict. Max OOS drawdown -0.2983 vs total return -0.2888 implies near-monotonic decline. Param stability not load-bearing: distinct-count rule passes but no reallocation would rescue a strategy losing money on the data it was fit to.

idea_name: Prior-Day Close-Location Reversal, Session Hold (NQ 15min NY, statistic frozen at the prior completed day, one round trip, no stop)
rationale: Iteration 30 (vol_level_polarity_switch) is retired as structural -- IS CAGR -0.0809 and IS profit factor 0.7556<=1 over 420 IS / 335 OOS trades fire both no-edge triggers -- so this is a clean pivot; per loop-review.md the pre-v2 accepted iterations 6/10/11 are not cited here as demonstrated edge (none gets a clean leave-top-5-out pass and none transfers to ES). The edge thesis transplants momentum-strategies.md's own stated reason for the skip period (S = skip period, usually 1 month to avoid microstructure mean reversion) together with mean-reversion.md's short-term-overreaction / forced-buying-and-selling mechanism: the most recent completed period is the one the vault asserts reverses, and across 30 iterations that period has only ever been skipped (iteration 20) or traded through, never traded as a reversal -- flagged honestly as a transplant (the claim is about individual equities at monthly horizon; index futures at daily horizon are closer to a random walk), not a base rate. What makes this a new shape rather than a 31st indicator is the holding geometry: the signal is frozen at the prior completed UTC day and the trade is exactly one round trip held to the session flatten, so metrics.py's fixed ~10.2bps toll is roughly 15% of a typical NQ open-to-close excursion instead of the ~40% that left iterations 21/22/24 bleeding ~-11bps/trade on event-triggered 15min entries. On gate v2's leave-top-5-out: uncapped run-to-flatten exits failed in iterations 6/10/11 because those entered on a new extreme, which selects for continuation tails -- this enters on a pre-frozen daily statistic with no intraday extremity condition, so P&L should be roughly symmetric across ~150-300 daily bets rather than tail-selected. Pre-registered power floor >=150 OOS trades (missed at 148, near-miss).
reasoning: All three gates fail independently, so no single check is doing the work alone -- but the absolute checklist and fold consistency are the clearest drivers, and the strategy fails in-sample before OOS generalization is even in question (IS CAGR -0.0419, IS profit factor 0.6159, IS Sharpe -0.7390). Step 2 is decisive and adequately powered: 43 active folds is well above the ~10-fold under-powered threshold, and only 46.5% were profitable against the vault's >60% aim, with median fold OOS return -0.11% and median fold OOS Sharpe -0.31 -- the typical fold lost money. Step 4 fails on OOS Sharpe (-0.2404 vs >0.8) and OOS profit factor (0.9166 vs >1.2); trade count (148>=30) and param stability both pass; max OOS drawdown -0.1542 exceeds OOS total return magnitude -0.0628, unremarkable for a net-losing equity curve. Step 3 returns robust:false on the profit_factor_ex_top5 clause alone (0.7018<0.9); removing the best 5 of 148 trades deepens the loss from -0.0586 (arithmetic sum) to -0.2095. Efficiency ratio deliberately not reported as a number -- both CAGR legs are negative, so the quotient (~0.56) would misread as acceptable for entirely the wrong reason.
